study: Button and Jones (2021), Rapid HPGe Well Detector Gamma Bioassay
scope: Caesium-137, 661 keV, no finite emission-time gate. Compare count-derived activity to a separately prepared reference across three concentrations.
validationSource: Tables 3 and 4, Cs-137 reference solution EZAG certificate 106645
emissionProbabilitySource: Method Analytes, Cs-137 paragraph; approximately 85% for the 661 keV photon
limits: Observed activities derive from real detector acquisitions but the paper does not give the raw peak counts here. This checks normalization transfer by holding the measured signal and the study's calibration fixed and changing only the source factor. It is retrospective, uses rounded table means, and carries no independent validation of nanosecond windowing.
